topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: The rain's been drumming on the windows all night, like a confession she can't quite spit out. Found out my old lady's been writing a novel, and guess who's the star of the show? Me, in black and white, a character she's playing with, reshaping as it suits her. Never thought I'd be in the pages of a book, didn't even know she had it in her. Words, though, they twist and turn, and by morning, they'll be something else entirely. Dark alleys of the mind, where the truth hides behind every corner. Not sure I want to read the ending, not yet, maybe never. Too many shadows in the room, and the night's young, or maybe it's just me.
